verdict.rationale: Rive's own docs describe several write-capable agent surfaces. Its official MCP integration lets AI create View Models, State Machines, Layouts and Shapes. RML lets agents create and modify Rive files as code. A CLI is advertised for agent-driven generation. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration of agent write workflows, detailed documentation of the full MCP tool set (described only as a 'first set of tools').

support.subject: As an AI-native user, an agent can create or modify designs programmatically — through a write-capable API, plugin surface, or MCP tools — not just read them

citations.quote: The first set of tools are designed to let AI handle repetitive tasks, like creating complex View Models, State Machines with hundreds of states/layers, Layouts, Shapes, and more.
It lets you create and modify Rive content as code, making it possible to build Rive files with coding agents and other text-based workflows instead of working exclusively in the Editor.
Build interactive UI, motion, and game experiences in the Editor, or let an agent generate them with the CLI.
